rv.q: That lends an odd but beguiling air of both urgency and otherworldliness to the story.
O’Reilly astutely captures the sentiment that no one leaves this crazy life without picking up at least a dash of eccentricity.

cn.t: O'Reilly's 2003 play earns solid praise for its intimate community portraits, drawing comparisons to Sherwood Anderson and Thornton Wilder in its depiction of characters navigating their small worlds.
